entries.speaker: Cupcakke
entries.text: Is this how things have to end? Miku…

entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: You were the best thing that could’ve happened to me in this life, I am so glad to have you as my best friend….

entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: My last wish.. is for you to become a world famous singer… Even if all you can sing is "vagina augh"...

entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: Please, carry on my dream, never let it fade away.

entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: Oh, and make a claim to the PingAn insurance, you can take all the money, it’s like a gazillion RMB.

entries.speaker: Cupcakke
entries.text: So you see, in order to honour my deceased best friend, she is now the logo of https://bitshare.com.cn/.

entries.speaker: Timothy
entries.text: Are you serious? Is this how you want to end the story?

entries.speaker: Anmol
entries.text: That’s such a shitty ending bro

entries.speaker: Revell
entries.text: Yeah like, what kind of best friend does that??

entries.speaker: Lyes
entries.text: Listen, the deadline is tomorrow, we don’t have time anymore

entries.speaker: Lyes
entries.text: Let’s just get this over with
